chat.title: Chat
chat.description: The Ask surface: send a conversational request to the connected Core. Ask never creates a durable Job and never submits work on the Run path — the two surfaces stay separate.
chat.runPointer: When a request requires durable work or approval, use the Run task path instead.
chat.modeAskNote: This surface is the Ask mode only. It never switches modes and never creates a durable Job.
chat.draftNote: The draft lives in this page's memory only, for the page's lifetime — nothing is stored on disk, and no secret belongs in a draft.

history.heading: Conversations
history.createFailed: The conversation could not be created.
history.emptyAllBody: Conversations you start appear here, most recently active first.
history.emptySearchBody: The Core's search found no conversation whose title or message content matches. Clear the search to see every conversation.
history.failureTitle: The conversation list could not be loaded
history.failureBody: The Core refused the list read. The code below is the Core's stable machine identifier; the reference is the safe correlation ID for diagnostics.
history.unknownTitle: The conversation list could not be confirmed
history.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the list read. Nothing is known about the list until a read is confirmed — this is never shown as an empty list.
history.connectionHint: Check that the Core connection is established, then refresh.
history.createUnavailable: The Core refused or could not confirm the creation. No conversation identity was issued to this page — nothing was created that this page knows of.

timeline.emptyBody: Send the first message below. It is recorded in this conversation's durable history.
timeline.roleUnknownNote: Unknown message role — shown verbatim as the Core recorded it.
timeline.noAnswerNote: This timeline ends at the recorded exchange. The Core's conversation surface records messages but has no answering path yet — no answer, stream, or completion confirmation exists to consume, and none is simulated here.
timeline.failureTitle: The messages could not be loaded
timeline.failureBody: The Core refused the timeline read. The code below is the Core's stable machine identifier; the reference is the safe correlation ID for diagnostics.
timeline.unknownTitle: The messages could not be confirmed
timeline.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the timeline read. Nothing is known about the messages until a read is confirmed — this is never shown as an empty timeline.
timeline.connectionHint: Check that the Core connection is established, then refresh.
timeline.notFoundBody: The Core has no conversation record for this address, or it is not accessible from this session. Nothing about any other conversation is revealed by this.

composer.label: Message
composer.pendingNote: The send is in flight. Sending again is disabled until the Core answers.
composer.pendingUnknownNote: The send's outcome is unresolved. Sending again is disabled until the request status is resolved.
composer.providerLine: Provider and model for this send: Not reported by the Core for this surface — the delivered send wire carries no provider or model selection.
composer.egressLine: Data handling for this send: the delivered send records your message in the Core's conversation store and creates no durable Job; no answering provider call exists to describe.
composer.enterHint: Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline.

send.rejectedBody: The Core refused the send. The code below is the Core's stable machine identifier. Nothing was recorded for this send unless the Core says otherwise; fix the message and send again.
send.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the send. A lost response is never proof of success, failure, or a safe retry — and this send has no idempotency key: the send-idempotency class is open, so nothing is re-sent automatically.
send.unknownBodyNoId: No confirmed response arrived for the send, and no request identity could be generated before sending — the outcome cannot be queried. Nothing is re-sent automatically.
send.statusCheckFailed: The status check could not be completed (Core code: {{code}}). The send's outcome is still unknown — check again.
send.statusCheckLost: The status check received no confirmed response. The send's outcome is still unknown — check again.
send.resolvedRecorded: The Core records this send as recorded: the message and its exchange are durably in this conversation. The timeline below is the authoritative state.
send.notRecordedTitle: The Core has no recorded exchange for this request
send.notRecordedBody: The status check resolved the outcome: nothing was recorded for this send. Your draft is preserved — sending again is a new request with a new identity, never a duplicate of the unresolved one.

announce.recorded: The send was recorded in the conversation.
announce.unknown: The send's outcome is unknown. Checking request status.
announce.resolvedRecorded: The unresolved send was confirmed recorded by the Core.
announce.resolvedNotRecorded: The unresolved send was confirmed not recorded by the Core.
